verdict.rationale: DBOS explicitly documents workflow versioning/patching strategies (dbos-docs-10), fork/replay to reproduce and roll back workflow state from any checkpointed step (dbos-docs-13), and the Conductor console explicitly offers 'Monitor, version, fork, replay, and observe durable workflows' plus pause/restart-from-step controls for incident response (dbos-docs-16, dbos-docs-21). This directly covers version, review, and rollback of automations, with scriptable API/CLI access for those operations (dbos-docs-17, dbos-docs-18). missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the rollback/version workflow in practice, and clarity on whether review/rollback UI is available without the separate paid Conductor product (community notes the web console isn't fully open-source, dbos-comm-11).
